levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: «حدثنا أبي» is Ibn Numayr's father, bare: relation
Abu Zur'a narrates the scene at Marwan's: Marwan speaks and is in the scene, not a link; Abdullah b. Amr is the last link, quoted as hearing the Prophet («سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول»)
«فذكر بمثله» is a pointer to the same wording: left out
